title: Every number you will be charged
subtitle: Not a summary of a quote — the structure of the real one, including the parts most agencies leave for later.

document.label: Sample quote · structure
document.status: Illustrative figures. Your numbers are confirmed in discovery — this structure is not.

scope.title: Scope and range
scope.body: One tier, one fixed scope, one range. The range narrows to a single number after discovery, and it does not move upward without a signed change order.
scope.note: The range is the honest part. A single number quoted before discovery is a guess wearing the clothes of a commitment.

schedule.title: Payment schedule
schedule.body: Milestone-based, never time-and-materials. You pay against delivered stages, and the bar below is drawn to the real proportions.
schedule.note: No deposit, no project start. That protects your build window as much as ours.

included.title: Included in year one
included.body: Domain, SSL, deployment, CI/CD, and base hosting for the first year — plus {warrantyDays} days of post-launch monitoring.
included.note: These are the line items that arrive later elsewhere as setup fees. They are already inside the figure above.

passthrough.title: Billed by others, not by us
passthrough.body: Stripe, Fawry, SMS gateways, and analytics tools are billed at their own standard rates, and only if your build actually uses them.
passthrough.note: Never marked up. We take nothing on top of a third party's price.

separate.title: Quoted separately
separate.body: Branding from scratch, copywriting, paid stock, email and SMS credits, and premium SaaS subscriptions sit outside the scope unless the scope lists them.
separate.note: Named here on purpose. A cost you can read in advance is not a surprise.

ownership.title: What you own at the end
ownership.body: Full source code ownership from the moment the final payment clears, permanently. No subscription, no plugin stack, no dependency on us to keep it running.
ownership.note: The last line matters most: nothing here rents you your own website.

start.label: To start — secures the build window

milestone.label: Mid-project — design and architecture signed off

launch.label: Before launch — due before the site goes live

footer.footnote: Sample document. Your quote is issued after discovery.
